# `get_task_tree`

**Get Task Tree.** Return the full subtask hierarchy for a single parent task.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | `string` | yes | — | The root/parent task ID whose subtree to display |
| `compact` | `boolean` | no | — | When true, show only the root task with a subtask count and progress bar instead of the full expanded tree. Default false (full tree). |
| `max_depth` | `integer` | no | — | Maximum nesting depth to render (default 4). Deeper subtasks are collapsed into a summary. |
